qcReview.tool: scripts/data/qc_render.py <packId> <outDir> [--crop]: decodes the packed DICOM and draws every reference target on it (contour sets on the image with the largest outlined area), so a shifted, flipped or misplaced outline would show
qcReview.selectionRule: CBIS-DDSM training-set breasts with CC and MLO, a single abnormality (id 1 only) with the same descriptors on both views, subtlety 4-5; 4 irregular spiculated malignant masses, 3 oval circumscribed benign masses, 2 pleomorphic clustered and 1 fine linear branching malignant calcifications, 1 lucent-centered and 1 coarse benign calcifications; women of mammo-cbis and the films rejected in round 3 excluded.
qcReview.review: Chest-wall side of every film checked against the recorded laterality (build_mammo asserts it), then all 22 kept outlines drawn on the films and checked by eye.

dropped.P_00023: right breast, but the chest wall is on the left edge of both films (mirrored scan?): the orientation cannot be trusted, so the hanging would be wrong

qcReview.leakCheck: study/series descriptions, role and display notes checked against LEAK (dataset names, diagnoses) at build
